skills.name: octodoc
skills.description: Find reviewed reusable PDF forms, fill facts the user supplied, open, review, summarize and prepare signable documents with OctoDoc, and check a sealed PDF offline against the digest its sender published. Invoke with /octodoc or $octodoc. Use for a contract, NDA, agreement, signature request, e-signature, sealed PDF, or signing status. Review and verification stay local, while summarize sends bounded canonical document text through Vercel AI Gateway and returns model output. A bearer [已隐藏] never authorizes a send or signature by itself: binding acts require a transaction-bound attended assertion or an explicit delegation mandate.
headings: Engagement contract and the guided interview
